title: SpectriX Ai zone v1
description: One restricted zone drawn on a still frame captured by the vision worker from the same stream it analyses. Coordinates are fractions of the full analysis frame: origin at the top-left corner, x increases to the right, y increases downwards, both from 0 to 1. The polygon closes automatically (the last point connects back to the first; do not repeat the first point). Some rules cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and are enforced by the API model (backend/app/schemas/zones.py): finite numbers, no near-duplicate vertices, no crossing or touching edges, and a minimum area.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Breaking changes publish zone.v2 instead of editing this file.

camera_id.description: Camera or recorded-video source the zone belongs to. Same identifier rule as the vision event contract.

zone_id.description: Unique per camera and never changed once created; incidents refer to it. Rename with `name`, not by changing the id.

kind.description: Zone type. Only restricted areas exist in v1.

enabled.description: Disabled zones are kept (so old incidents still resolve) but never alert. Deleting a zone means disabling it.

version.description: Starts at 1 and increases by 1 on every saved change to the zone.

points.description: Polygon corners in drawing order (clockwise or anticlockwise). Objects rather than [x, y] pairs so the list can be stored directly in Firestore, which does not allow arrays inside arrays.

x.description: 0 = left edge, 1 = right edge of the analysis frame

y.description: 0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge of the analysis frame

reference_frame.description: The still frame the zone was drawn on. Its size must equal the frame size the worker analyses; a mismatch means the zone needs review.

captured_at.description: RFC 3339 with a UTC offset (e.g. Z or +05:00). The pattern enforces the offset even in validators that ignore `format`.
